name: gopass-task-manager
description: Gestión de tareas por proyectos — React 18 + Node/Express + PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix api run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.validate:coverage: npm --prefix api run test:coverage && sdlc coverage-diff
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build
